newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude set for rangebound session.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude set for rangebound session.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
+ NYMEX crude faces rangebound day with little on the technical horizon to suggest an imminent breakout.
+ June crude support at $19.90 and around $19.40.
+ Heat may be pulled up by expiry gap to 57.50 cents.
+ Gasoline rangebound, support at 62.40, resistance at 63.30.
NYMEX crude futures faced another rangebound session on Friday, with few signals on the technical horizon to indicate direction, chartists said.
NYMEX June crude futures closed 30 cents lower at $19.91 a barrel while, heating oil ended 0.59 cent at 54.33 cents a gallon and gasoline ended a 0.22 cent off at 62.63 cents.
"We're set for another rangebound session," said Bob MacMinn, president of MPAS Inc in Toronto.
He pegged support for the contract around $19.90 in line with Thursday's lows and then at $19.40 and $18.96. He saw key resistance around the $20.50 level.
"It's a very tricky market at the moment," he said, noting that momentum packages flipped over four or five times recently.
Analysts at MeesPierson in London were looking to take advantage of the range play.

"Preparation is still neutral and therefore we must continue to buy dips, buying at $20 if volume appears again above this level otherwise we wait for a dip to the old range lows at $19.80," they said in their daily bulletin.
The products markets were looking similarly rangebound.
On the heating oil front chartists said a gap, spanning 55.40 to 57.50 cents, left on the spot continuation charts by the expiry of the May contract could provide some impetus for a move higher.
"We bought at 54.60 on the closing fall off and wait today for range highs (55.40) today to take profits," said MeesPierson in their daily bulletin.

"If we can get back above 54.50 cents in early trade we can continue to add to length here, if volumes however develop below 54.30 we assume a return to the old range and therefore cut any length held higher up."
On the gasoline front, MeesPierson pegged support at 62.40, 61.90 and 61.50 cents and resistance at 63.30, 63.70 and 63.90 cents a gallon. -- Melanie Goodfellow, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7714
